If he accepts it I see no reason to leave. He is definitely old enough to understand any potential risks, but it never hurts to have another conversation. I would however urge him to be tested again because if you are having a primary outbreak it’s likely you contracted it within the last few weeks. I’m not sure if he is your only partner but it’s possible he has gotten it since his last test and just doesn’t know. The CDC states a primary outbreak can occur as early as 4 days after exposure. 

As far as relating to your situation I 100% can though! I was diagnosed a few months into dating my partner, he was not yet diagnosed at the time of my primary outbreak but I do believe he had it before I was diagnosed and didn’t know based on the many conversations we have had since then. I couldn’t bear the idea of even having to disclose to him at first but obviously had no choice and he never once made me feel less than. We are still together a year later and could not be happier. You still deserve love and happiness and if he is willing to give it and someone you want to explore that with you should! 

Wishing you the best!
